title: UserActEvidenceV1 (internal domain contract)
description: First-class user-act evidence contract owned by native transcript normalization (engine/crates/membrane-transcript::evidence) and consumed by Adapt. Records what happened; never states the final preference. Internal Adapt-domain contract; not a public Membrane protocol shape.

act_kind.description: snake_case serde of ActKind; only non-accept kinds are user-authoritative from an authenticated external_user origin.

byte_end.description: Fail-closed: byte_end >= byte_start and digest must match the span's exact bytes.

scope_context.description: Structured scope context observed at act time (repo, language, ...).

signal_strength.description: Weighting strength; affects confidence/review only, never authority class.

provenance_receipt.description: Digest of the provenance receipt binding this evidence to its source; mandatory.
